translations.接收端会按事件编号去重: The receiver deduplicates by event ID
translations.仅在接收端能用 Idempotency-Key 或 eventId 识别并忽略重: Enable only if the receiver uses Idempotency-Key or eventId to ignore duplicate events. Otherwise, uncertain deliveries are marked for review and are not automatically retried.

translations.跨文件夹搜索每页检查最多8个文件夹，每个文件夹先显示5封。: Cross-folder search checks up to 8 folders per page and previews 5 messages per folder.

translations.批量任务部分完成，请检查失败文件夹: Batch partially completed; check failed folders
translations.文件夹加载失败，请刷新后重试: Could not load folder; refresh and retry
translations.邮件加载失败，请刷新后重试: Could not load mail; refresh and retry
translations.部分邮件操作失败，请刷新后重试: Some messages could not be updated; refresh and retry

translations.正文超过10 MB，暂不预览；可下载附件或导出原始邮件。: This message exceeds 10 MB. Download attachments or export the original email.
translations.单次下载上限100 MB；下载不会修改邮件已读状态。: Downloads are limited to 100 MB and do not change read status.
translations.当前通过 HTTP 连接。密码会交给服务器校验，但传输过程无法抵御窃听或网页劫持: You are connected over HTTP. The password is verified by the server, but the connection cannot prevent interception or page tampering. Configure HTTPS before exposing this service publicly.
translations.不开放公开注册。管理员在这里创建用户，每个用户只能管理自己的邮箱账号、同步任务和: Public registration is disabled. Each user can manage only their own mail accounts, sync jobs, and mailbox folders. Users should change the initial password under Personal security after first sign-in; administrators cannot reset it.
translations.当前连接是 HTTP，登录密码和会话无法抵御网络窃听或中间人劫持。可信内网可临时: This connection uses HTTP. Your password and session are not protected against network interception or man-in-the-middle attacks. Use it temporarily only on a trusted LAN; public access requires HTTPS.
translations.将以下范围全部标为本地已读（包含所有分页）？: Mark all local messages in the following folders as read (all pages)?
translations.部分文件夹失败，请刷新后重试: Some folders failed; refresh and retry
translations.主动打开邮件会标为本地已读；账号数字表示收件箱未读数。: Opening a message marks it read locally; account badges show inbox unread counts.
translations.首次使用,请创建管理员账号(密码至少10位): First use: create an administrator account (minimum 10 characters)
translations.还没有添加任何邮箱账号 ·: No mail account has been added ·
translations.只同步最近多少天: Only sync the most recent days
translations.填写 Google 应用专用密码（16位），不是 Google 登录密码；需先开: Enter a Google app password (16 digits), not your Google sign-in password. Two-Step Verification is required.
translations.使用OAuth2授权，支持离线自动刷新访问令牌；需要已配置 HTTPS 回调地址: Uses OAuth2 with offline token refresh; a configured HTTPS callback URL is required.
translations.这里修改的是本地 Dovecot 用户: This changes the login password for local Dovecot user
translations.默认 16 MB；超出后保留日志开头和最后 1 MB，避免异常账号耗尽磁盘: Default 16 MB; oversized logs keep the beginning and final 1 MB to prevent a faulty account from filling the disk
translations.默认同步间隔(新建账号时的初始值): Default sync interval for new accounts
translations.保存后刷新页面生效。: Save and refresh the page to apply.
translations.服务器会保留最近7天的恢复前快照：: The server keeps pre-restore snapshots for 7 days:
translations.每行一个完整名称，例如： INBOX Sent: One full name per line, for example: INBOX Sent
translations.每行一个完整名称，例如： Trash Junk: One full name per line, for example: Trash Junk
translations.该 Provider 使用 OAuth2。保存后会跳转到服务商授权页面；请先在: This provider uses OAuth2. After saving, you will be redirected to its authorization page. First configure the credentials on the
translations.配置对应的 Client ID、Client Secret 和回调地址。: with the corresponding Client ID, Client Secret, and callback URL.
translations.隔离模式会把该账号的完整文件夹层级放到一个独立顶层文件夹中；原样汇聚可能与其他账: Isolation places this account's complete folder hierarchy under a separate top-level folder. Merging may combine same-named folders from different accounts.
translations.修改隔离策略会清除可重建的同步缓存；显示名称可以修改，服务器实际隔离目录由系统分: Changing the isolation policy clears rebuildable sync cache. The display name is editable, while the server assigns the actual isolated folder to prevent cross-user conflicts.
translations.留空表示同步全部文件夹。名称按源邮箱中显示的完整路径精确匹配。: Leave blank to sync all folders. Names must exactly match the full paths shown by the source mailbox.
translations.排除规则优先；这里不会删除源邮箱中的任何内容。: Exclusion rules take priority. Nothing in the source mailbox is deleted.
translations.镜像模式会永久删除本地目标端中源端已不存在的邮件，但绝不会删除源邮箱邮件。仅账号: Mirror mode permanently deletes local destination messages that no longer exist at the source, but never deletes source messages. Available only with account isolation.
translations.⚠ 镜像删除已开启。首次正式同步前建议先完成备份并查看同步日志；此模式不能同时设: ⚠ Mirror deletion is enabled. Back up and review the sync log before the first production sync. Message age and size limits cannot be used in this mode.
translations.所有未单独配置目标用户的外部邮箱，默认同步到此本地 Dovecot 用户。已单独: External mailboxes without their own destination user sync to this local Dovecot user by default. Accounts with a specific destination do not follow this change.
translations.保存后仅影响新建账号的默认值,不会修改已有账号。: This changes only the default for new accounts; existing accounts are not modified.
translations.保存后刷新页面生效。当前页面会继续使用切换前的语言。: Save and refresh the page to apply. This page continues using the previous language until refreshed.
translations.留空则保留现有密钥: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
translations.修改会先验证当前密码，写入新密码后立即用新密码实际尝试登录一次确认生效， 整个过: The current password is verified first. After writing the new password, the application immediately performs a real login. Dovecot and local-target.pass remain consistent, and any failure is rolled back.
translations.VM 内存有限时建议保持 1~2,避免多个 imapsync 同时跑爆内存: Use 1–2 on a memory-constrained VM to avoid concurrent imapsync processes exhausting memory.
translations.默认 120 分钟；超时后先请求退出，10 秒后仍未结束则强制终止: Default: 120 minutes. On timeout, graceful exit is requested first and the process is forced to stop after 10 more seconds.
translations.默认 90 天；服务启动时及之后每 24 小时自动清理已结束任务和对应日志，不会: Default: 90 days. Completed jobs and logs are cleaned at startup and every 24 hours; queued and running jobs are preserved.
translations.修改后立即生效,不需要重启服务。已有账号的间隔不受影响。: Applies immediately without a restart. Existing account intervals are unchanged.
translations.⚠️ 修改端口后需要重启服务才会生效,保存后请点击下方「重启服务」或手动执行: ⚠️ Port changes require a service restart. After saving, use Restart service below or run
translations.需要先分别在 Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Entra 注册: Register Web applications in Google Cloud and Microsoft Entra, then add the callback URLs below exactly as shown. Client secrets are stored only in server files with mode 600 and are never displayed.
translations.正式环境必须使用 HTTPS，不要带路径；仅 localhost/127.0.0: Production must use HTTPS without a path. HTTP is allowed only for localhost/127.0.0.1 testing.
translations.个人 Outlook 和多租户一般使用 common；企业也可以填写租户 ID: Personal Outlook and multi-tenant applications usually use common; organizations may enter a tenant ID or domain.
translations.会发送 JSON 事件，不会包含邮箱密码或授权码。: Sends JSON events without mailbox passwords or app passwords.
translations.同一账号连续失败时，在冷却时间内仅发送一次通知。: Repeated failures for one account send only one notification during the cooldown period.
translations.修改后立即生效,刷新页面就能看到,不需要重启服务。: Applies immediately; refresh the page to see it. No service restart is required.
translations.备份包含账号数据库和邮箱密码或授权码，不包含邮件正文、日志、缓存或会话签名。通知: The backup contains the account database and mailbox passwords or authorization tokens. It excludes message bodies, logs, cache and session signing data. Notification settings and secrets stay on this server and are not exported or restored. Store the backup encrypted offline and never upload it to a public repository.
translations.先上传并只读预检，不会立刻改动系统。正式恢复前会自动保存当前数据库和密钥快照；邮: Upload and perform a read-only inspection first. Before restoration, the current database and secrets are snapshotted automatically. Message bodies, the current administrator, sessions, and the current local Dovecot password are preserved.
translations.只会重启 mail-aggregator 这一个服务,不影响 Dovecot 和: Restarts only mail-aggregator and does not affect Dovecot or other services. The minimal sudo permission described in the README is required; otherwise run
translations.卸载操作不可通过网页撤销。程序卸载会删除 Mail Aggregator 和运行: Uninstallation cannot be undone from the Web UI. Application removal deletes Mail Aggregator and its runtime data but preserves Dovecot and mail. Full removal also deletes Dovecot, the local mailbox user, and all messages in Maildir.
translations.卸载操作不可通过网页撤销。程序卸载会删除应用、账号和凭据，保留邮件。彻底卸载只额: Application removal deletes the app, accounts and credentials and keeps your mail. Full removal also removes a local Maildir if installer ownership can be confirmed. Shared mail services remain installed.
translations.这里显示已同步到本机 Dovecot 的邮件，只读查看不会修改邮箱内容。: Messages synchronized to local Dovecot appear here. Read-only viewing does not modify mailbox contents.
translations.选择一封邮件查看正文: Select a message to read it
translations.远程图片可能让发件人知道你打开了邮件，并看到你的网络地址。: Remote images may tell the sender that you opened the message and reveal your network address.
translations.内嵌图片和安全排版已还原；脚本、表单、外部样式和危险布局始终被屏蔽。: Embedded images and safe formatting are preserved; scripts, forms, external styles, and dangerous layouts are always blocked.
translations.内嵌图片和安全排版已还原；远程图片仍被拦截，脚本和危险布局已移除。: Embedded images and safe formatting are preserved; remote images remain blocked, and scripts and dangerous layouts were removed.
translations.远程图片已由你主动加载；脚本、表单、外部样式和危险布局仍然被屏蔽。: You chose to load remote images; scripts, forms, external styles, and dangerous layouts remain blocked.
translations.这封邮件没有可显示的正文: This message has no displayable body
translations.默认 512 MB；低于此值时不再启动新同步，避免系统盘被写满: Default 512 MB; new syncs stop below this reserve to prevent the system disk from filling
translations.智能文件夹仅保存筛选条件，不复制邮件。: Smart folders save filters without copying mail.
translations.确认删除这个保存的搜索？邮件不会被删除。: Delete this saved search? Your mail will be kept.
translations.保存的搜索文件夹已不存在或无权访问，请编辑搜索范围。: The saved folder is missing or inaccessible. Edit the search scope.
translations.保存搜索暂时不可用，请稍后重试: Saved searches are unavailable. Try again later.
translations.每个用户最多保存50个搜索: Each user can save up to 50 searches

translations.旧备份保留当前搜索: Older backup: current saved searches retained
translations.检查邮件盘、inode、helper 和磁盘安全余量。: Check mail storage, inodes, helper and disk reserve.

translations.修改规则会使旧预览失效；请重新预览后应用。: Editing a rule invalidates its previews. Preview it again before applying.
translations.仅应用此次完整预览中的邮件；10分钟后需重新预览。新邮件不会加入。: Only mail in this complete preview will be changed. Preview again after 10 minutes. New mail is excluded.
translations.服务重启后任务会中断。重新登录后可手动继续；已提交但未确认的结果会先核对。: Tasks stop after a service restart. Sign in and resume manually; unconfirmed changes are checked first.
translations.确认删除规则？已开始的应用任务仍可在任务中心查看。: Delete this rule? Existing application tasks remain in the task center.
translations.正文或内嵌图片超过预览预算；可下载附件或导出原始邮件。: The body or inline images exceed the preview budget. Download attachments or export the original message.
translations.预览不完整、已过期或规则已修改，请重新预览: The preview is incomplete, expired, or the rule changed. Preview again.
translations.文件夹 UIDVALIDITY 已变化，请重新选择范围创建任务: A mailbox was rebuilt. Select the scope again and create a new task.
translations.当前用户已有邮件任务，请先完成或取消: You already have a mail task. Complete or cancel it first.
translations.每个用户最多保存50条规则: Each user may save at most 50 rules.
translations.邮件任务暂时不可用，请稍后重试: Mail tasks are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
translations.该任务不能继续，请重新选择范围: This task cannot resume. Select the scope again.
translations.该任务已失效，请重新选择范围: This task is invalid. Select the scope again.
translations.预览超过500个文件夹，请收紧范围: Preview exceeds 500 folders. Narrow the scope.
translations.预览超过50000封匹配邮件，请收紧条件: Preview exceeds 50,000 matching messages. Narrow the filters.
translations.处理未完成；未确认的标记将在继续前核对: Processing is incomplete. Unconfirmed flags will be checked before resuming.
translations.任务未完成，请检查连接后继续: The task is incomplete. Check the connection before resuming.
translations.服务已重启，请重新登录后手动继续: The service restarted. Sign in and resume manually.
translations.应用已恢复，请重新选择范围创建任务: The application was restored. Select the scope again and create a new task.
translations.任务已取消；已提交命令的结果待核实: The task was cancelled. Submitted changes still need verification.
translations.任务已因维护中断，请手动继续: Maintenance interrupted this task. Resume it manually.

translations.服务无法启动时，在服务器上运行: If the service cannot start, run on the server
translations.安装会短暂重启 Web。同步、邮件任务或备份恢复忙碌时，更新会顺延。: Installing briefly restarts the Web service. Updates wait for syncs, mail jobs, and backups or restores to finish.

translations.正在进行其他维护操作。: Another maintenance operation is in progress.
translations.等待下个维护时段。: Waiting for the next maintenance window.
translations.该版本需要手工升级。: This version requires a manual upgrade.
translations.此环境仅支持检查更新，请按发布说明手工升级。: This deployment can check for updates. Follow the release notes to upgrade manually.
translations.本机或当前版本未开放自动安装。: Automatic installation is disabled for this deployment or version.
translations.需要管理员固定发布公钥并启用本机安装。: Pin the release public key and enable installation on this host first.
translations.该版本已失败，不会再次自动安装。: This release failed and will not be attempted automatically again.
translations.本机 Web 配置未通过预检。: The Web configuration did not pass preflight.
translations.应用包未通过本机预检。: The application package did not pass preflight.
translations.已下载并校验，等待维护时段: Downloaded and verified; waiting for the maintenance window
translations.Web 服务状态不可确认。: The Web service could not be confirmed.
translations.无法连接本机更新服务。: The local update service is unavailable.
translations.GitHub 限流，稍后重试。: GitHub rate-limited the request. Please retry later.
translations.发布签名验证失败。: The release signature did not verify.
translations.候选版本已变化，请重新检查。: The release has changed. Check again.
translations.新版未通过就绪检查。: The new version failed its readiness check.
translations.回退未完成，请检查服务器。: Rollback did not finish. Check the server.
translations.暂存或数据库磁盘空间不足。: Not enough space for staging or the database.
translations.时区无效，例如 Asia/Shanghai。: Enter a valid time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai.
translations.请填写不同的起止时间及有效时区。: Choose different start and end times and a valid time zone.
translations.确认开启自动安装，维护时段时区: Enable automatic installation in this time zone
translations.确认安装并重启 Web: Install and restart the Web service

translations.浏览器类别用于辨认登录记录。旧会话没有完整记录，使用后会出现在列表里。: Use the browser name to recognize a sign-in. Older sessions appear in the list after they are used again.
translations.退出其他全部设备: Sign out of all other devices
translations.确认退出其他所有设备？: Sign out of all other devices?
translations.请选择未来 180 天内的时间。: Choose a time within the next 180 days.

translations.已跳过此版本的自动安装。: Automatic installation will skip this version.
translations.更新后清理尚未完成，请检查服务器。: Cleanup after the update is incomplete. Check the server.
translations.当前环境仅检查版本: This platform can only check for updates
translations.本机公钥无效: The local public key is invalid
translations.已固定公钥，未启用本机安装: The release key is pinned; installation is disabled
translations.已固定并启用发布公钥: The pinned release key is enabled
translations.此机尚无安装记录: No installation history on this server
translations.此机没有管理更新执行器: No update service on this server
translations.曲线显示各时段的最低可用容量。缺少读数时，曲线留空。: The charts show the lowest available capacity in each interval. Gaps mean there were no readings.
translations.记录已完成的网页请求。异步安装或回退的最终结果请查看应用更新历史。最多保留最近: Completed Web requests only. See application update history for installation and rollback results. Up to 10,000 records from the last 30 days are retained.
translations.部分运维记录无法保存: Some operations records could not be saved
translations.仅主管理员可以管理管理员或只读运维账号: Only the primary administrator can manage administrators or operators
translations.仅通知订阅后的结果。应用更新通知需要本机更新执行器。: Only results recorded after subscribing are sent. Update notifications require the local update service.
translations.先在服务器上校验配对归档，再选择生成的规划报告。报告仅在浏览器中读取，网页不会校: Verify the paired archives on the server, then select the generated plan. The browser only reads the report; it neither verifies archives nor restores live mail.
